Under legacy semantics, both the default `"auto"` and explicit `"multiindex"` resolve to non-flat snapshots. `create_model` still obtains `sns` from the unchanged `as_index(n, snapshots, "snapshots")` call and passes that same `sns` to the variable and constraint builders; the new context does not flatten component data in this case. Changes within builders do not change which snapshots `create_model` hands them.
